strings.name: Hiroshi Amano
strings.role: Semiconductor researcher and Nobel physics laureate
strings.summary: Hiroshi Amano studies gallium nitride and related semiconductors. In Isamu Akasaki's team he developed low-temperature buffer layers and p-type conductivity that enabled efficient blue LEDs. With Akasaki and Shuji Nakamura he shared the 2014 physics Nobel, supporting energy-saving white light. At Nagoya he continues power-device research and international training collaborations.

strings.highlights.h1.title: Overcoming blue-light materials barriers
strings.highlights.h1.text: With Akasaki's team he advanced high-quality GaN and p-type conduction for blue devices.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Efficient lighting and future electronics
strings.highlights.h2.text: Blue LEDs enabled efficient white light; he continues nitride power-semiconductor research and international collaboration.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Uzbek honorary professorship
strings.timeline.t1.text: A National University of Uzbekistan delegation presented the honorary title in Nagoya, strengthening academic exchange.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Future-electronics center leadership
strings.timeline.t2.text: He became director of Nagoya IMaSS's integrated future-electronics research center.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Shared Nobel Prize in Physics
strings.timeline.t3.text: With Akasaki and Nakamura he was recognized for efficient blue LEDs.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Returning to Nagoya as professor
strings.timeline.t4.text: He moved from Meijo to Nagoya's Graduate School of Engineering.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Teaching at Meijo
strings.timeline.t5.text: He joined its science and technology faculty and continued nitride research.
strings.timeline.t6.title: p-type GaN and doctorate
strings.timeline.t6.text: The team achieved p-type GaN and p-n-junction emitters; he earned his Nagoya engineering doctorate that year.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Low-temperature buffer layers
strings.timeline.t7.text: Under Akasaki he advanced high-quality GaN growth on sapphire and completed his master's course that year.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Engineering undergraduate degree
strings.timeline.t8.text: He graduated from Nagoya's engineering school and continued graduate studies.
